sections.heading: Help Us Reach Our Goal of 100% Participation
sections.html:
Every Family Counts. Every Gift Matters.

Give Now

Every gift will be doubled by a generous donor up to the first $15,000, from Now through Giving Tuesday!

Susan believed every child deserves the chance to grow through Play, Nature, and the Arts— her vision was a world where children are free to imagine, explore, and connect. Your gift fuels Sunflower’s joyful model of education — supporting every child, honoring Susan’s legacy, and building a strong future together.

“If you can imagine a better world, you can make a better world.” — Susan Caruso

sections.heading: Did you know Sunflower is a nonprofit?
sections.html:
Sunflower Creative Arts is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to empowering children and families through Play, Nature, and the Arts.

Tuition and program fees do not cover the full cost of operating Sunflower programs. Each year, fundraising bridges the gap and helps sustain the creative, nurturing, play-based learning environments our children enjoy.

sections.heading: Your Giving Makes a Difference
sections.html:
• Support our teachers and their professional growth.
  • Maintain and improve our campus and outdoor playspaces.
  • Provide hands-on materials and enriching learning opportunities.
  • Sustain Sunflower programs and advocate for Play, Nature, and the Arts.
